projects.title: Merge a Brainrot
projects.summary: A Roblox game about merging Brainrots, hatching Lucky Eggs, rebirthing, and fishing for treasure.
projects.detail: I am part of the team behind Merge a Brainrot. Our And Fish for Treasure community brings together merging, collection, and a fishing loop. The game is preparing for release; this page links to our group for launch updates.

projects.title: HokieWallet
projects.summary: A student finance dashboard prototype bringing budgets, spending, and campus wallet information into one view.
projects.detail: At VTHacks, I worked with three teammates on HokieWallet, a student finance prototype built with TypeScript, Next.js, and React. The dashboard uses shared sample data to show balances, spending categories, recent transactions, and savings goals. This project helped me practice team collaboration and think through how financial information can be easier to understand. It is a prototype; it does not connect to real bank or university payment accounts.

projects.title: Trucking workflow tools
projects.summary: Exploring a simpler way to organize asphalt tickets, loads, rates, and driver hours.
projects.detail: Working with my dad’s trucking business made me want to apply what I learn in CS to everyday operations. I plan to explore tools for organizing tickets and calculating driver payouts from loads, rates, and hours. This idea is in planning and is not a finished payroll product.

projects.title: Carlos OS Portfolio
projects.summary: A personal portfolio with a searchable project catalog and shareable project briefings.
projects.detail: This portfolio began as a Virginia Tech CS 2104 class project. I supplied the concept, visual direction, personal background, and project content, and used OpenAI Codex to assist with implementation and testing. The Flask application queries a SQLite project catalog, supports search and category filters, and creates bookmarkable briefings from selected projects. It is packaged with Docker, tested with Python, and now hosted publicly on Render.
projects.stack: Python, Flask, SQLite, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, Docker
